markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (33%)** · Ambiguous: Benign vs Invasive · Careful review
Close split (Benign 33%, Normal 33%, Invasive 23%) keeps Invasive in the 90% conformal set [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Benign 33%, Normal 33%, Invasive 23%, InSitu 11% | Three-way split; no winner |
| Conformal set | Normal, Benign, Invasive (90% coverage) | Cannot exclude invasive carcinoma |
| Reliability / OOD | 94% reliability, 68th percentile OOD [F6] | Typical input; passes QC |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree on top class | Backbones agree; low confidence |
| Similar cases | 2/5 Benign (40%) [F5] | Neighbors split across classes |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 9, 10, 11) · ↑ invasive · Strongest invasive push (+1.08) along inferior edge [F2] · Validated
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 0, 1, 3) · ↓ invasive · Unreliable (-0.75; 0/20 spot check) opposing invasion [F3] · Unreliable
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (regions 1, 2, 5) · context · Descriptive (-0.75); differs from InSitu BACH_0339 [F4] · Weak
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 5, 6, 8) · ↑ invasive · Unreliable (+0.33; 0/20 spot check); discount · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; deleting top 3 risk regions drops invasive score above random (CI +0.002 to +0.020).
- **Concepts**: Unproven (deletion CI -0.009 to +0.006 includes 0); uses unreliable normal lobules (0/20), mitoses (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Invasive tumor in regions 8–11 (87%–100% risk) is diluted by zero-risk regions 0–3 in this composite image.
- Unreliable normal-lobules scoring (-0.75; 0/20 AI spot check) falsely offsets validated stromal invasion.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 8, 9, 10, 11**: High invasive risk (87%–100%) and validated stromal invasion; confirm or exclude carcinoma.
2. **Regions 8, 9, 10, 11**: Check positive inferior (323 um), medial (215 um), and lateral (215 um) margins [F7].
3. **Regions 0, 1, 2, 3, 5**: Inspect lobules and TILs where unreliable lobule and mitosis concepts fired.
